title: Zero divisors on a module over a Noetherian ring form the union of its associated primes
statement: Let $R$ be a Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and $M$ an $R$-module. An *associated prime* of $M$ is a prime ideal $\mathfrak q\subset R$ equal to $\operatorname{Ann}_R(z)=\{a\in R:az=0\}$ for some $z\in M$; write $\operatorname{Ass}_R(M)$ for their set. An element $x\in R$ is a *zerodivisor on $M$* if $xz=0$ for some nonzero $z\in M$. Then the set of zerodivisors on $M$ equals $\bigcup_{\mathfrak q\in\operatorname{Ass}_R(M)}\mathfrak q$.
